title: 10K Races in Malaysia's JomRun Series (2026)
intro: All four races here belong to the same JomRun-powered lineup, each pairing a 10K with a half marathon and 5K on the same morning, so the real choice is about city and month rather than distance. Kuala Lumpur opens the run in August, then Rawang and Johor Bahru follow back-to-back in September, before Kuala Terengganu closes it out on Halloween weekend in October. That gives a spread from Malaysia's capital to a coastal east-coast city, with Rawang and Johor Bahru offering more regional, less crowded settings in between. Anyone comparing these is really weighing timing and location, since the distance menu stays identical across all four.

faqs.question: Are these races all the same distance option?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every race listed — in Kuala Lumpur, Rawang, Johor Bahru, and Kuala Terengganu — offers the same three distances: 21.1km, 10km, and 5km, all run on one event day, so the 10K is consistently available as the middle option at each stop.

faqs.question: When is the busiest stretch for these races?
faqs.answer: September is the busiest month, with the Rawang Half Marathon on September 13 and the Tebrau City Half Marathon in Johor Bahru on September 20, just a week apart. August has one race in Kuala Lumpur, and October closes with Kuala Terengganu on the 31st.

faqs.question: How do Kuala Lumpur and Johor Bahru compare as race settings?
faqs.answer: Kuala Lumpur hosts the KL Half Marathon in August as the capital-city option, while the Tebrau City Half Marathon in September takes place in Johor Bahru, also known as the BMW Millennium Welt Johor Half Marathon — a southern Malaysian city near the Singapore border.
